decision.observation: The gate's right post carries the latch hardware: a pipe lever on the top rail at ~(0.845, 0.40) with a curly bell-crank below at ~(0.88, 0.55); the left post has two hinge-like fittings. The goose stands on the path in front of the gate.
decision.hypothesis: The top-rail pipe latch may be above standing beak reach; flapping (X) while pressing on it might let the goose reach and operate it.
decision.memory: Left post fittings = hinges; right post = latch mechanism.
